mobility.name: Mobility, flexibility & gymnastics
mobility.description: A companion to your lifting: activation before and stretching after, by day (Pull, Legs 1, Push, Legs 2).
mobility.notes:
A companion to your lifting, organised around the muscle groups you train each day. Three goals at once:
• Joint prep: range of motion and a body ready to lift.
• Flexibility: front and middle splits, spinal extension and shoulders.
• Gymnastics: handstand, body control, scorpion and backbends.

How to use it
Each day has two workouts: "Before" (activation plus, on Pull and Push, gymnastics), done before lifting, and "After" (static stretching at moderate tension, pain-free), done at the end.

Suggested week
Mon: Pull + handstand and scorpion · Tue: gymnastics/flexibility · Wed: Legs 1 + front split · Thu: gymnastics/flexibility · Fri: Push + handstand · Sat: Legs 2 + splits · Sun: rest (optional light mobility).
On gymnastics days, go easy on wrists and shoulders if they're already tired from lifting.

"Per side" sets: 2 sets = 1 each side; 4 sets = 2 each side.

Mobility isn't flexibility
• Mobility: actively controlling a joint through a range. That's the activation part.
• Flexibility: reaching and holding bigger ranges. That's the end of the session.
Don't spend 10 minutes in a deep front split right before heavy leg work.

Active strength
Splits and handstands improve with strength in those positions, not just passive stretching: active leg raises (front split), Cossack squats (middle split), hollow holds and pike compressions (handstand).

Goals to track
Front split right and left · Middle split · Pike with chest close to legs · 30 s handstand · Aligned, controlled handstand · Scorpion · Bridge with open shoulders.
You don't need to hit the floor yet. What counts is quality time accumulated, without forcing your joints.

workoutNotes.pullBefore:
Before lifting, 10–15 min. Dynamic activation (Cat-Cow through Dead Hang), then gymnastics: wall handstand 20–30 s, scorpion and bridge.
Focus: shoulder extension, thoracic mobility and body control.
workoutNotes.pullAfter:
After lifting. Static stretching at moderate tension, pain-free. If you've still got energy, add 2 × 20 s of gentle bridge.
Focus: thoracic extension, shoulders and opening the front of the body for the scorpion.
workoutNotes.legsABefore: Before lifting, 10–15 min. Hips, knees and ankles ready for squats, leg press and extensions. The active leg raise builds strength for the front split.
workoutNotes.legsAAfter:
After lifting. Progressive front split: 30–45 s per side; add time once it feels comfortable.
Focus: quads and hip flexors on the way to the front split.
workoutNotes.pushBefore:
Before lifting, 10–15 min. Activation (wrists through pike shoulder taps), then gymnastics: chest-to-wall handstand 20–30 s, shrugs, pike compressions and hollow hold.
Focus: holding strength, alignment and shoulder stability.
workoutNotes.pushAfter: After lifting. Open up the chest and shoulders that lifting tightens, and build the range your handstand needs.
workoutNotes.legsBBefore: Before lifting, 10–15 min. Prep for Romanian deadlifts and leg curls. The Cossack squat builds strength for the middle split.
workoutNotes.legsBAfter:
After lifting: your main leg flexibility day. Front split 30–60 s and middle split 30–45 s, no rush. Finish with the pancake (seated straddle).
Focus: hamstrings, glutes, hip flexors and adductors.
